sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint; nominal 27B language model, vision encoder, hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention layout, native 262144 context, text/image/video examples, optional thinking and tool calling.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with 64 dense text layers: three linear-attention layers per full-attention layer; intermediate_size 17408, no expert routing, vision configuration, one MTP layer and max_position_embeddings 262144.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository created February 24, 2026; Apache-2.0 metadata; safetensors reports 27781419504 BF16 and 8448 F32 parameters, total 27781427952.

sources.title: Official Qwen series release timeline
sources.evidence: The official repository (formerly Qwen3.5) explicitly dates Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B release to 2026-02-24 and links the released weights.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index and referenced safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read the 11 indexed shard headers and summed all 1199 tensor shapes: language model including embeddings/output head 26895998464; vision 460730096; MTP 424699392. Sum 27781427952 matches repository metadata. Dense FFN tensor names confirm no expert tensors.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B license
sources.evidence: Checkpoint license is Apache License, Version 2.0. Browser reader failed, but direct HTTPS retrieval succeeded.

name.note: Display formatting of official Qwen3.5-27B name.

developer.note: Qwen is Alibaba Group’s model team.

release_date.note: Official timeline explicitly announces this open checkpoint on February 24; repository creation corroborates it. Correct the catalog’s February 23 date; no API-listing date is substituted.

open_weights.note: Public post-trained weights are provided in the official repository.

license.note: Exact checkpoint license and metadata agree.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint tensor count, including vision and MTP. Independently summed published tensor shapes, not weight-file bytes. The model card’s 27B labels the language model nominally.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count is published for this dense checkpoint. Do not substitute total, non-embedding, or language-only parameters; vision and MTP participation depends on the inference path.

architecture.note: Exact configuration and FFN tensors establish dense architecture with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full gated attention and a vision encoder. The card’s generic family-highlight MoE statement conflicts with its exact-model layout and must not classify this variant.

context_window.note: Native configured context; card separately documents extension to 1010000 tokens.

modalities.note: Exact checkpoint examples demonstrate all three inputs and generated text.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and may be disabled through enable_thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact serving commands enable tool calling; the card also provides Qwen-Agent usage.

description.value: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling
description.note: Concise description grounded in the exact checkpoint’s architecture and documented capabilities.

patch.description: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 27.781427952B parameters, comprising 26.895998464B language model including embeddings/output head, 0.460730096B vision and 0.424699392B MTP. The card’s 27B is a nominal language-model count. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full attention; generic family MoE wording does not describe this checkpoint. Native context 262144; documented extension to 1010000.

summary: Correct release to February 24, add Apache-2.0 and dense architecture, and replace nominal 27B with the verified complete checkpoint count of 27.781427952B. Keep active parameters null. Confirm native context, modalities, optional thinking and tool calling; distinguish exact-model dense layout from generic family MoE wording.
